messages.author: 0ebfa823f5ba1c0a
messages.subject: Distance older versions
parts:
Hi, 

My name is Sara, and I have a question about different versions of Distance software: 

 A few years ago (maybe 4/5 years) I made an analyzes in Distance 6.1 Beta 1 or Distance 6.0 (I cannot remember for sure) and now I'm repeating some of those analyzes in Distance 7.1 (version that I have installed now) and the values of the abundance and density estimates are not equal, the latest version gives relatively higher values than the older version.

Is it normal for this to happen? estimates of density and abundance give different values in different versions of Distance?

And another question:  Do you have the older version, Distance 6.1 Beta 1 or Distance 6.0, cause I would like to run the analyzes in both versions and compare!


Thank you in advance for your availability, 

Sara Sá

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Distance older versions
parts:
Sara

It is not normal to get different density estimates from different versions of Distance.  We test the releases to check that new versions give the same estimates before release.

Note also that the current version of Distance (released last month) is version 7.3.  We suggest you update to our most recent version.  We can make older versions of Distance available, I believe we did not publicly release a Distance 6.1, but jumped from Distance 6.0 to Distance 6.2.  I'll make a copy of Distance 6.2 available for a short time at this link

https://www.dropbox.com/s/8oulxxw8qft8y5a/d62setup.exe?dl=0
I'll be interested to hear what you learn.
